session.title: Switchy 1.0.20: Claude account cards show the right email and usage
session.purpose: the user reported the in-use Official Claude card showing no email or usage, and a switch carrying the previous account's usage onto the new card; he directed the fixes, a version bump, changelog, rebuild, reinstall and push.
outcomes: Root cause of the blank in-use card: the proxy hand-back writes ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.anthropic.com into Claude Code settings, which backfilled into that provider's stored config; the card list treated any base URL as third-party, so it hid the email and never fetched usage. ProviderCard now counts Anthropic's own address as Official (fdb612e8).

Stale usage after a switch: the backend's last-good usage cache for the live Claude login was keyed by tool only and the frontend query by app only; both are now keyed by the live login / owning card (5517d1f9).
Capturing a login in the edit dialog now reloads the provider list, and saving the dialog keeps a capture made while it was open (f2b402e7).

Version 1.0.19 -> 1.0.20 with a [1.0.20] changelog section holding all three fixes; built, reinstalled with the one-command sequence (installed exe 1.0.20, port 15721 listening), pushed to origin main at fdb612e8. the user confirmed the card now shows correctly.
Not done: scripts/publish_public.sh and the GitHub release for 1.0.20 were not run; the public repo and release page still show 1.0.19.
Unexplained: when the Apple-relay account's card first went non-current it showed no usage even though its snapshot login was valid; no log line shows why.

session.latest_summary: Fixed Claude card email/usage display bugs; 1.0.20 installed and pushed, not publicly released.

current_focus.summary: Wait for the user's feedback on the installed 1.0.20 build, and get his calls on the open proxy-off verification and the quit case.

next_actions.summary: VERIFY LOCAL PROXY OFF WITH AN OPEN CODEX WINDOW. the user was asked to turn Local proxy off in Settings > Pool, then use a Codex window opened while the proxy was on. Confirm in C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.log that "Proxy turned off; its listener stays up..." was logged, that the Codex window's later [Codex] requests still reached the proxy and answered, that netstat shows 127.0.0.1:15721 still LISTENING, and that Settings shows the proxy as off. Turning it back on must reuse the listener.

QUIT CASE WAITS ON STEPHEN. Quitting Switchy still breaks Codex windows opened under the proxy. He was offered a warning on quit naming the open Codex windows (small) or running the proxy as a process that outlives Switchy's window (large); he has not chosen. Build nothing until he does.

Wait for the user's feedback on the installed 1.0.20 build. If a Claude card again shows no usage after switching away, inspect switchy.log immediately and query https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage with that card's snapshot token (~/.switchy/accounts/<id>/credentials.json) to separate an Anthropic refusal from a display fault. Reinstall with the one-command sequence in CLAUDE.md. A release is: bump the four version files, date the changelog section, CI=true pnpm build, commit, push origin, run scripts/publish_public.sh, then gh release create on registered2nd/switchy with both installers; 1.0.20 has had every step except the last two.
If the user directs request logging to be enabled, first make the Usage page's Turn on button apply to the running proxy, then enable it for Claude, Codex, and Gemini.
